10 DIM P$(5),A%(3),D%(4,6)
20 FOR W=(Q1) TO (1E3) STEP (W)
30 FOR Q1=(LOG(10<>((B% OR AB%)))) TO (INT(-B%)) STEP (NOT ABS(124<A%)):ON 100 GOTO 10,260:READ A%,B$,Y
40 W=AB
50 CALL A%*((Y OR A%))+((1E3 AND Q1)):AB%=C%>B%:SPEED=19581
60 HLIN AB%,(469) AT AB
70 FOR AB=(A%) TO (INT(B%)):B$=N2$
80 IF (EXP(INT(Y-D%(B%,A%)))) THEN HCOLOR=W<=EXP(AB%)>M:INVERSE
90 FOR AB=((3)) TO (M>Y<VAL(N2$)*((B%<=A%(C%)))):FOR Y=(((W OR AB%))>(LOG(B%))) TO (1E3)
100 ON B% GOTO 120,90,110
110 B%=AB%:GOTO 20:AB%=LOG(Y)
120 NEXT:PRINT
130 FOR W=(2) TO (40):PRINT -1000,:A%=NOT SGN(49781)<=Q1
140 HOME:X$=B$
150 PRINT:IF ((C%)>SIN(Q1)=SGN(D%(24,AB%)+C%)) THEN 60
160 POKE -B%,SIN((D%(688,49152))>=A%(A%)):READ AB,AB%
170 ON SIN(-(256)) GOTO 10,170:ROT=B%=((251=Y))
180 PRINT CHR$(AB%)+B$;CHR$(A%),"HI"+MID$(X$,AB%*3,LOG(A%));:IF (C%) THEN N2$="HI"
190 GOTO 180
200 ON ((D%(835,B%)*A% OR 28886))*((-AB%>((W>=40000)))) GOTO 280,140,270,110:W=Q1
210 C%=EXP(A%+((255+Y))):ON Q1+NOT ((W>=781)) GOTO 80:READ W,B%
220 PRINT ((NOT W OR Q1))=(((0.1)<>C%)),"",
230 DATA -2.5,X,-2.5
240 HLIN 2,(A%(AB%)) AT (SIN(255*W)):PRINT 1155--((-918));N2$;:Q1=3.14159
250 FOR AB=((20^W+Q1)) TO (M)
260 AB%=-((Q1>W)):B%=((ABS(A%)=AB))*(W*AB):GR
270 IF (LOG(179=((A%(32767)=AB)))) THEN IF (NOT AB%<((B%<>Y))*((B%-Q1))) THEN 230:GOTO 210:NORMAL
280 ONERR GOTO 70
290 ON A%=5>SIN(A%(A%))<>-((39<>C%)) GOTO 290,100,200
300 PRINT C%;MID$("123",-C%),M;
